text:
Priya (PM): Quick sync on Console observability deliverable for finance teams — they want a 'Finance Kit' that includes per-route cost breakdowns, an exportable chargeback CSV, trace linking, and error fingerprinting. We need to decide what ships in MVP vs GA. Constraints: 2 full-time engineers allocated this quarter.

Liam (Eng-Platform): My priority order from an engineering effort POV: 1) Exportable aggregated CSVs by route/time window, 2) trace->cost link (sampled), 3) error fingerprint list with samples, 4) exact per-invocation attribution. Exact attribution has big surface area (billing pipeline integration).

Ava (Eng-ML): For cost we can do a lightweight model-based estimator using per-model token profiles + observed token counts per-batch. That gives ~92% correlation in our lab tests. If we emit per-request 'est_cost' and 'est_confidence' fields, product can show a confidence band.

Carlos (Sales): Customers in AR/AP care about exact numbers for chargebacks. They won't pay for Preview unless we promise a migration path to exact metrics. But Preview with clear labeling + exportable aggregates helps close deals faster in the short term.

Tess (Customer Success): Two customers asked specifically for: (a) CSV shaped like invoice rows (route, start_ts, end_ts, tokens, cost), (b) ability to map cost rows to examples/traces for audits. They are OK if rows say "estimated" for hosted.

Priya (PM): Proposal: ship a Finance Kit Preview on hosted with these constraints: 
- Aggregated CSVs: per-route aggregates for arbitrary time windows (user chooses route set, time range). Marked as ESTIMATED.
- Trace linking: for each route aggregate we provide sample traces (by sampling policy).
- Error analytics: top-25 fingerprints with sample traces + quick RCA tags.
- GA (dedicated/private): exact per-invocation attribution, deterministic cost numbers, and a reconciliation job for billing.
Is everyone OK with that split?

Liam (Eng-Platform): Acceptable. Implementation notes: for Preview we only need incremental metrics pipeline work (emit per-request estimated token counts + route tag), aggregate in metrics store, expose CSV export. For trace linking we add a small index from route->sampled-trace-ids. Sampling policy needs product guidance.

Ava (Eng-ML): Sampling: suggest adaptive sampling that increases sample rate for errors and for high-cost outliers. Pseudocode we used in spike:
```
if error_count > 0 or est_cost > threshold: sample_rate=0.1 else sample_rate=0.01
emit(sample)
```
This keeps storage small but surfaces problematic cases.

Carlos (Sales): Can we commit to a phrase for customers: "Preview = estimated costs; Dedicated = audited billing". Need that in the docs.

Tess (Customer Success): Also need a migration playbook: how customers move from Preview to Exact. They want to know what breaks in their chargeback scripts.

Priya (PM): Acceptance criteria for Preview (hosted):
- UI: Finance Kit page with top N routes (default N=20), time range, and export button.
- CSV spec: columns [route, start_ts, end_ts, total_tokens_est, est_cost, confidence_pct, note].
- Trace linking: clicking a route opens sampled traces pane with at least 5 examples if available.
- Error analytics: fingerprint table with count, first_seen, last_seen, sample_trace_id.
- Documentation: clear label and migration playbook.

Liam (Eng-Platform): Risks: token estimation drift when we change quantization/precision or batching logic. We'll add a model-version tag to the metrics so we can correlate. Also, we need to ensure export doesn't include PII.

Ava (Eng-ML): For the GA exact attribution we need to: 1) instrument runtime to emit per-request token delta post-dequantization, 2) make cost attribution idempotent for retries, 3) wire to billing pipeline and add reconciliation. Ballpark: 4 sprints across infra + runtime owners.

Priya (PM): Trade: Preview = fast time-to-customer. GA = revenue-grade accuracy and nightlies. We should gate GA on internal reconciliation tests and SLA signoff.

Carlos (Sales): Sounds fine if we don't overpromise. Please give me a one-pager I can show customers.

Tess (Customer Success): I'll assemble a list of customers willing to pilot Preview (I have 3: VertexHealth, EmberDesk, and ComplyCo).

deploy-bot: Created ticket FINKIT-101: "finance kit: preview CSV export + trace linking" assigned to eng-platform, eng-ml. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FINKIT-101

Priya (PM): Next steps: 
- Liam/Ava: deliver tech-spike results and a simple API shape for CSV and trace-linking by Wed EOD.
- Tess: confirm pilot customers and draft migration playbook.
- Carlos: I will draft external wording for sales.

Liam (Eng-Platform): I'll post a spike doc with estimated infra cost and retention numbers.

Ava (Eng-ML): I'll attach the estimator accuracy plots and the sampling config.

Priya (PM): Thanks team. We'll review spikes and finalize scope in Friday PM sync. :thumbsup:
